result.title: SWAP-INR: Implicit Neural Representation with Switchable Attention Paths for Time-varying Multivariate Scientific Data Compression
result.summary: Visualizing multivariate scientific simulation data is essential for understanding complex physical phenomena, yet the massive scale of such data imposes a severe storage bottleneck in high-performance computing environments. Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a promising continuous alternative to traditional lossy compressors, but existing methods struggle to explicitly capture cross-variable interactions and to adapt to the diverse spectral characteristics of physical variables. To address these limitations, we propose SWAP-INR, an architecture for high-fidelity compression of multivariate, time-varying simulation data. SWAP-INR introduces two key components: (1) The switchable attention path (SWAP) module explicitly models cross-variable interactions through a cross-variable attention layer, then routes each variable to an attention or non-attention path by a deterministic, loss-driven criterion, and prunes the inactive layers for structural compression. (2) The adaptability amplification SIREN (A2-SIREN) replaces rigid frequency scaling with channel-wise learnable modulation, adapting to heterogeneous physical features with negligible overhead. Combined with post-training 16-bit quantization, SWAP-INR achieves state-of-the-art performance on small modular reactor (SMR) datasets and remains competitive on public physics simulation datasets, while maintaining a constrained memory footprint. Our code is https://github.com/hvcl/SWAP-INR.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SWAP-INR，用于多变量时序科学仿真数据的隐式神经表示压缩：以跨变量注意力显式建模变量交互，再按损失驱动的确定性准则把每个变量路由到注意力或非注意力路径并剪枝未激活层，同时用通道级可学习频率调制替代固定缩放，配合训练后 16 位量化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按确定性损失准则在注意力/非注意力路径间路由并剪枝」可供核查是否能为 LVR 中视觉旁路与潜空间路径的按需选择、动态计算预算分配提供线索；但研究对象是科学数据压缩，不涉及推理状态生成或答案使用。
